title: Sunday Quick Tip
subtitle: Silly rules, real skills
hook: What if every goal had to be scored with the weak foot?
intro: Kids keep using the same moves.
Telling them to try something new does not work.
statement: A silly rule can teach what a lecture cannot.
q1: Do you add playful rules to games —
q2: or keep games realistic so they match real play?
q3: Which habit would a silly rule break?
t1: There is no perfect answer here. But kids try new things
t2: when the rules make it fun to.
cta: Coaches — what silly rules do you use?
ctaLines: Weak foot only. Three passes first. Hop on one leg.
ctaPrompt: Share your favorite rule below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
What if every goal had to be scored with the weak foot?
Kids keep using the same moves. Telling them to try something new does not work.
A silly rule can teach what a lecture cannot.
Playful rules or realistic games. Both can work.
What silly rules do you use? Share your habit in the comments.
